verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
-ESSANYU lingi mu ggulu
Ennanga nga zivuga;
Era bamalayika
Bayimba nnyo mu bbanga.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Naffe abali mu nsi,
Ka tukube enduulu;
Nti wa la-la-la-la-la!
Ozaana waggulu-ennyo

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ka tuyimuse gy'oli
-Emitima gyaffe gyonna
Okwagala kwo kungi
Okwakuleeta mu nsi.
